title: The spectral fingerprints of sleep stages, recovered against expert hypnograms

dataset.name: Sleep-EDF Database Expanded (sleep-cassette)
dataset.record: SC4001 + SC4011 nights; EEG Fpz-Cz + Pz-Oz @ 100 Hz, 30 s epochs, expert-scored hypnograms
dataset.citation: Kemp B, Zwinderman AH, Tuk B, Kamphuisen HAC, Oberye JJL. Analysis of a sleep-dependent neuronal feedback loop: the slow-wave microcontinuity of the EEG. IEEE Trans Biomed Eng. 2000;47(9):1185-94. Goldberger AL, et al. PhysioNet. Circulation. 2000;101(23):e215-20.

proposition: Grouped by the expert hypnogram, the ecosystem recovers the textbook per-stage EEG spectra: deep sleep (N3) is the most delta-dominated / slowest spectrum (relative delta 0.92 night 1, 0.91 night 2 - the highest of all five stages), the spectrum slows monotonically as sleep deepens (relative delta rises N1 < N2 < N3), and N2 carries the sigma-band spindle peak - reproduced across both nights.

claims.statement: N3 relative delta power, night 1 (highest of all stages)
N3 relative delta power, night 2 (reproduces the deep-sleep peak)
relative delta increase from N1 to N3, night 1 (spectrum slows with depth)
N2 relative sigma (spindle band) power, night 1 (peak among stages)
N2 relative sigma (spindle band) power, night 2 (reproduces the spindle peak)

validation.reference: Expert AASM manual sleep scoring - the hypnograms distributed with Sleep-EDF - used to group each 30 s epoch by its true stage
validation.data: REAL - Sleep-EDF Expanded (PhysioNet), nights SC4001 and SC4011, EEG Fpz-Cz + Pz-Oz
validation.note: Aggregate acceptance: the four canonical per-stage spectral relations hold in BOTH nights - (1) N3 has the highest relative delta of the five stages; (2) relative delta rises N1 < N2 < N3; (3) relative beta falls N1 > N2 > N3; (4) N2 has the highest relative sigma (spindle band). What does NOT reproduce, reported honestly: the built-in one-threshold spectral classifier does not match the expert hypnogram (agreement 0.089 / 0.048) - on these frontal, delta-dominated ambulatory spectra it collapses to N3 - so eegSleepStage is used here as the per-epoch spectral feature extractor, not as a validated scorer. Wake also sits off the depth ladder (relative delta ~0.81-0.85) because the frontal Fpz-Cz derivation picks up ocular/movement activity when awake; the fingerprint orders the SLEEP stages by depth, it does not separate wake.

open_questions.q: The convenience classifier in eegSleepStage (a single relative-power threshold) does not reproduce expert scoring on this ambulatory frontal montage (agreement < 10%); whether artifact rejection plus richer features/channels would recover clinical-grade automatic staging is a real question, but building an automatic scorer is out of this case's scope. Documented, not escalated.
